- While casting this skill, Suoming is immune to interruption. During this time she cannot move, sprint, jump, dodge, or cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>, <color=Highlight>Plunging Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color>, or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, and Resonator switching is also restricted.

<size=40><color=Title>Unison</color></size>

When Suoming's Concerto Energy is full and she has <color=Highlight>Unison</color>, only the <color=Highlight>Unison</color> effect is consumed.

Suoming can trigger <color=Highlight>Unison Response</color>.
When a Resonator in the team has <color=Highlight>Unison</color>, swiching to Suoming grants all Resonators in the team <SapTag=0>{0}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=0} of <color=Highlight>Unison Boon</color> for {1}s.

<size=40><color=Title>Unison Boon</color></size>
Each stack of <color=Highlight>Unison Boon</color> increases DMG dealt by Resonators in the team who can trigger <color=Highlight>Unison Response</color> by {2}%, up to {3} stacks.

<size=40><color=Title>Delusion Gain Rules</color></size>
Can hold up to {4} points of Delusion.
- Hitting a target with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy</color>, or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder</color> grants Delusion.
- Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> grants <SapTag=5>{5}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=5} of Delusion.
- Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Thunder Rending</color> or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder (Unison)</color> grants <SapTag=6>{6}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=6} of Delusion.
